name: Italo Moletto-Lobos
subtitle: Remote Sensing Data Engineer · Operational Satellite Data Pipelines, PostgreSQL & Cloud
summary: PhD in Remote Sensing and data engineer who builds and runs operational satellite data pipelines: automated ingestion into PostgreSQL/PostGIS, cloud workflows on Azure, AWS and HPC, production monitoring with Jira, and tested, containerised code with CI/CD. My pipelines feed NASA Harvest yield forecasts in seven countries and ESA WorldCereal global crop calendars, backed by 10 years of climate-focused Earth observation research.

highlights.label: Master geospatial repository for global crop calendars
